summary.text: Anna Munson is the Republican and Libertarian candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democratic incumbent Tom Andersen.
She lists her profession as adjunct faculty and says she works as a legislative aide at the Oregon Capitol.

paragraphs.text: Anna Munson earned a high school diploma from Monte Vista High School and an associate degree from Grossmont College in 1977, and lists her career experience as an adjunct faculty member.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Munson described herself as a mother, a grandmother and the wife of a disabled veteran, and said she and her husband have lived in their home for more than 45 years.
She said she currently works in the Capitol as a legislative aide, teaches constitutional studies at the college level, and previously worked in health care and as an election board worker.
Munson advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.

She said she is running to bring affordability through accountability to the Oregon Legislature, and she named affordability, with a focus on how state tax money is spent, and education as campaign priorities.
